Name: Gold-Accented Iridium Tools
Author: casinosluck
Description:
Ever irritated by how the iridium tools don't match the return scepter? This mod fixes that.

Modified sprites:
[list]
[*]Iridium Pickaxe
[*]Iridium Axe
[*]Iridium Watering can
[*]Iridium Trashan
[*]Iridium Pan (yes, even the pan.)
[*]Iridium Scythe
[/list]
Unmodified sprites: [i](No plan to modify these, but subject to change)[/i]
[list]
[*]Both Iridium fishing rods
[/list]
